title.narrative: Multitranche Financing Facility (MFF) - Improving Access To Health Services For Disadvantaged Groups Investment Program - Tranche 1

description.narrative:
Tranche 1 proposed for financing under the requested periodic financing request (PFR) aims to contribute to the investment program's impact of improving the health status of Mongolians.
The investment project comprises the following outputs:
(i) urban and rural primary health care strengthened, (ii) district and aimag hospital services improved, (iii) health financing system strengthened, and (iv) capacity in procurement and financial management of relevant government entities for health strengthened.
